summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience building end-to-end ML pipelines: training GPT-2 style Transformers from scratch, fine-tuning document-understanding foundation models (DONUT), and deploying inference systems to production users. Skilled in Python and PyTorch; background spans LLM fundamentals, custom ASR pipelines, agentic multi-modal systems, and LLM compression for constrained deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset for structured text extraction — full training pipeline in PyTorch including preprocessing, evaluation, and model checkpointing.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through targeted preprocessing improvements and hyperparameter tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained and evaluated YOLOv8 on a custom annotated dataset, improving classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5%; deployed model to a consumer mobile application with real production users.
Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset for health-level classification, establishing evaluation baselines and tracking accuracy metrics across training runs.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline: custom image stitching (PSNR 86), wavelet denoising, and ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling (±8% error on 3D reconstruction).

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch — multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, weight tying; built TikToken tokenizer wrapper, custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a multi-modal agentic pipeline: faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s) → Gemini LLM intent classification (<500ms) → TensorRT YOLO visual servoing (~18 FPS) → robotic action — end-to-end voice-to-pick latency ~11.5s.
Resolved 11 integration failures across the full agentic loop (false-positive detections, servo crosstalk, stereo depth); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced TinyLlama 1.1B memory footprint by ~25% via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization; benchmarked on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with ~7% accuracy drop and +6.3 perplexity increase.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 6-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention, trained on 1,000 Indian-English samples; achieved training loss ~0.51 and 15% WER.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50 ~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); validated in Town02 (30 vehicles, 10 pedestrians) — zero collisions, correct traffic-light compliance across multiple laps.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
